content.description: Illustration showing hands inspecting power steering pump bushing and measuring clearance with a tool

items.title: INSPECT BUSHING AND MEASURE BUSHING OIL CLEARANCE

steps.label: (a)
steps.text: Check bushing for wear or damage. The bushing cannot be replaced separately.
If wear or damage is found, replace entire housing.

steps.label: (b)
steps.text: Check the oil clearance between the bushing and rotor shaft.

content.description: Two side-by-side illustrations showing rotor shaft bearing removal and installation using a press

items.title: IF NECESSARY, REPLACE ROTOR SHAFT BEARING

steps.label: (a)
steps.text: Using snap ring pliers, remove the snap ring.

steps.label: (b)
steps.text: Using a press, press out the bearing.

steps.label: (c)
steps.text: Using a press, press in the bearing.

steps.label: (d)
steps.text: Using snap ring pliers, install the snap ring.

content.description: Illustration showing hands measuring rotor and cam ring with measurement tools

items.title: INSPECT ROTOR AND CAM RING
items.text: Measure the cam ring thickness. Check that the difference between the rotor and cam ring measurement is less than maximum.
items.note: If the difference is excessive, replace the cam ring with one stamped with the same letter on the rotor.

content.description: Illustration showing hands measuring vane plate dimensions with measurement tools

steps.label: (a)
steps.text: Check the vane plates for wear or scratches.

steps.label: (b)
steps.text: Measure the length, height and thickness of the vane plates.

items.label: (c)
items.text: Measure the clearance between the vane plate and rotor groove.
